**Q2:** Count days from 2008-03-22 to 2015-10-19.
- 2008-03-22 → 2015-03-22 is 7 years. The only leap day in that span is 29 Feb 2012, so the span is 7×365 + 1 = 2556 days.
- 2015-03-22 → 2015-10-19: day-of-year 292 − 81 = 211 (2015 is not a leap year).
- Total: 2556 + 211 = 2767. **Y = 2767**.
